repos.name: SmartATS
repos.description: AI-powered resume optimization platform. Upload a resume and a job description to get an ATS compatibility score, a keyword match heatmap, prioritized improvement suggestions, one-click resume tailoring, and a matching cover letter.

repos.name: SmartATS-Foundation
repos.description: An AI-powered Resume and Job Description Matcher built with Streamlit and Python. This tool analyzes resumes against job descriptions, computes a matching score, and provides smart feedback using language models. Designed to help job seekers and recruiters improve alignment and save time.

repos.name: QuickText
repos.description: Full-stack SaaS app (React, FastAPI, Gemini) that turns uploaded documents into structured AI insights: summaries, flashcards, quizzes, and action items in seconds.

repos.name: InStocks
repos.description: A minimalist, full-stack inventory tracker built with React, FastAPI, and PostgreSQL. It features a highly condensed, easy-to-read codebase designed specifically for learning and clarity.

repos.name: Question-Paper-Generator
repos.description: AI-powered web app that instantly generates meticulously formatted, bilingual (English/Hindi) question papers and answer keys (.docx) from uploaded PDFs using Groq & Streamlit.

repos.name: Gemini-Chatbot
repos.description: The Gemini AI Chatbot is an interactive chatbot powered by Google's Gemini 2.0 Pro API, built with Streamlit in Python.
